# Portfolix v0.1.7 (Build 18)
## 修复与改进
- 适配 DeepSeek 最新模型列表，自动移除已下线模型，并保持基础模式与联网增强能力一致。 - 更新 DeepSeek Responses API 与内建联网搜索的调用和结果校验逻辑。 - 修复 App 升级后后台行情组件可能停止运行的问题。 - 修复调度记录缺失时错误延后更新的问题；已到期的行情任务会按原计划补跑。 - 后台行情写入完成后立即同步至前台，减少重新打开 App 后的显示延迟。
## Fixes and Improvements
- Updated the DeepSeek model catalog integration to remove retired models and keep analysis modes aligned with model capabilities. - Adapted the DeepSeek Responses API and built-in web search request and validation flow. - Fixed an issue that could stop background price updates after an app upgrade. - Restored overdue schedules from their last recorded run instead of delaying them after relaunch. - Synchronized completed background quote updates with the foreground immediately.
